sources.title: Optimization and Tuning - vLLM
sources.snippet: When chunked prefill is disabled, max_num_batched_tokens must be greater than max_model_len. In that case, if max_num_batched_tokens < max_model_len, vLLM may crash at server start‑up.

sources.title: Conserving Memory - vLLM
sources.snippet: If a hint exceeds what the model can accept, vLLM clamps it to the model's effective maximum and may log a warning. For Qwen2-VL-family models, increasing max_model_len can increase the profiled video size and reduce the memory available for the KV cache. Profiling remains subject to the processor's pixel limits and the frame cap.
